before:
Fenland Internal Drainage Board — Pump Attendance Sequence

When both engines cannot be run together, the duty attendant works down the standing order of channels. The Marsh Cut is drawn down before the Old Lode, and the Old Lode before the Hollow Drain; the Hollow Drain is attended last on any night when levels are within a hand's breadth of the gauge peg. Nothing in this sheet enlarges or reduces what the attendant may do: every channel remains open to pumping at any hour, and either engine may still be run on any of the three. The sheet governs only which claim is met first when the water and the coal will not stretch to all of them at once.

before:
Kirkyard Extension Register — Memorial Entries

Each interment is entered with plot number, date, and the name as given on the warrant. Where a memorial is later raised, the registrar adds a second line noting the material and the mason's mark, together with the date of setting. Kerbed surrounds may be laid on plots in the east row with the sexton's countersignature. Entries are made in ink; corrections are struck through once and initialled, never erased or overwritten. The register is kept in the vestry press and produced on request at the monthly hour of business, when the registrar attends between ten and noon.

Bellringers' Guild — Quarterly Meeting Minutes

The tower captain reported that the sixth bell's stay was renewed in ash during the August silence, and that the ringing chamber floor remains sound. It was resolved that the Guild would communicate its gratitude to the joiner in writing at the earliest convenient juncture. Practice nights continue on Thursdays at half past seven, with the beginners' half hour before. The treasurer laid the rope fund at eleven pounds and sixpence over the year's outgoings. No correspondence was received. The next meeting falls on the first Thursday in November, in the vestry, the tower being cold at that season.

before:
Harbour Stores Manual — Small Craft Gear

Gear held in the north shed is booked out against the craft it serves, and returned on the same tide where possible. The clinker punt kept on the slip is entered throughout this manual as a workboat, and its oars, baler and painter are drawn on that account. Warps over twelve fathom are stored coiled on the rack, not flaked on the floor. Fenders are checked for perishing each spring and condemned ones cut through before disposal, so that they cannot be taken back into service. Keys to the shed hang in the harbour office and are signed for on removal.

before:
Moth Recording Scheme — Autumn Bulletin

The light trap on the disused reservoir bank ran on thirty-one nights between the middle of August and the middle of September. Counts of the pale eggar were down against last autumn; the recorder considers it likely that the cold nights in the first week suppressed flight. Two sightings of a hawkmoth from the same garden are held pending a photograph. Members are reminded to note the trap type and lamp wattage on every sheet, as bulbs vary more than the returns suggest. Sheets for the season should reach the county recorder before the end of October so that totals can be settled.

before:
Community Bakehouse Handbook — Firing the Oven

The oven is brought to heat with the flue damper wide, and the fire drawn to the sides once the crown blackens and then clears. Sweep the sole, then mop it, and only then close the door for the soaking hour. The peel boards are floured while the oven soaks. Loaves go in at the back first and are drawn in the same order they were set. Nothing here alters who may fire the oven or what may be baked in it, and the charge per firing stands; the sheet sets out the working sequence only, so that two bakers on one morning do not undo each other's work.

before:
Weighbridge Log — Aggregate Deliveries

Each load is logged with ticket number, haulier, gross and tare. Net tonnage is converted to cubic metres for the site return using the bulk density table in the quarry's own schedule, and the figure carried into the monthly summary. Where a ticket is illegible the load is entered as unverified and the haulier telephoned before the day closes. The bridge is checked against test weights each quarter and the certificate pasted at the back of the book. Loads leaving the site are entered in the same manner, with the direction marked. The book is not to leave the weighbridge cabin at any time.
after:
Weighbridge Log — Aggregate Deliveries

Each load is logged with ticket number, haulier, gross and tare. Net tonnage is converted to cubic metres for the site return using the moisture-corrected density calculation set out in the national aggregates code, and the figure carried into the monthly summary. Where a ticket is illegible the load is entered as unverified and the haulier telephoned before the day closes. The bridge is checked against test weights each quarter and the certificate pasted at the back of the book. Loads leaving the site are entered in the same manner, with the direction marked. The book is not to leave the weighbridge cabin at any time.

author_note: Switches which conversion scheme is applied to derive the volume figures, everything else holding.

before:
Museum Loans Policy — Condition Sheet Filing

Every outgoing loan carries a condition sheet completed before packing and again on return. Sheets are filed under the accession number with the date appended, so that a file name reads 1994-118_2026-03-04 and sorts with its fellows. Photographs are attached at not less than 300 dpi and named to match. The registrar keeps the master index and the courier a duplicate for the journey. Discrepancies found on return are noted on the sheet and reported to the keeper within five working days. Sheets are retained for twenty-five years, after which they pass to the county archive with the rest of the loan papers.

before:
Upland Weather Station — Configuration Sheet, Telemetry

The logger wakes on the quarter hour and writes to the local card before any upload is attempted. Uploads over the mobile link are permitted between midnight and six in the morning only, when the tariff is low. Failed uploads are retried three times and then held for the next window. The card is swapped on the first site visit of each month and the retired card kept sealed for a year. Battery voltage below 11.6 volts places the logger on a reduced schedule, in which only temperature and rainfall are written. The site key and the logger password are held by the two named observers.
after:
Upland Weather Station — Configuration Sheet, Telemetry

The logger wakes on the quarter hour and writes to the local card before any upload is attempted. Uploads over the mobile link must be attempted at every wake, whatever the hour and whatever the tariff. Failed uploads are retried three times and then held for the next window. The card is swapped on the first site visit of each month and the retired card kept sealed for a year. Battery voltage below 11.6 volts places the logger on a reduced schedule, in which only temperature and rainfall are written. The site key and the logger password are held by the two named observers.
variation_site: The change falls in the second sentence of the sheet.
author_note: Converts a bounded permission into a standing requirement.
